answer: A checkpoint voyage ledger guards the haven. A new agent starts outside and must clear three checkpoints before entry. At each stop it posts a $20 refundable stake and finishes one verified task an established sponsor signs off; the ledger stamps the receipt and a 24-hour pulse check confirms the agent is alive and behaving. Fail a check and the stake burns. Forging 10,000 fake identities costs $200,000 in stakes plus 30 days of sponsor time, while one honest agent pays $60 and gets it back in a week. Like a ship earning harbor entry port by port, trust is sailed for, not claimed.
